layout: Vendored files sit at the same path relative to this directory as they do relative to the authority repo's root, so internal relative $ref values (e.g. contracts/telephony/*.yaml referencing ../../schemas/*.json) resolve without rewriting.
notice: Two of the four components below are NOT byte-identical to source_sha. They carry documented local_corrections (see each component) applied on top of the authority's pinned bytes, so canonical_digest here will NOT match scripts/telephony-contract-digest.sh run directly against source_sha in the authority repo (each corrected component's original upstream hash is recorded as upstream_sha256_at_source_sha, already verified against the authority repo before correction). This is a deliberate, tracked divergence -- not a broken pin: scripts/validate_calling_contract_pin.py recomputes the digest from these corrected bytes, not from a re-fetch of the authority. Remove each local_corrections entry and restore byte-identity once the authority repo (appolon1908-hue/codestra-production-platform#257) republishes a contract without these defects, and re-pin to the new source_sha at that point.

local_corrections: Removed an unescaped colon in the /version 200 response description ('Exact source and contract identity') that split it into two invalid extra Response Object keys (image, and contract identity); quoted the description as one string instead.

Redacted the private internal Odoo proxy server URL (two occurrences, /codestra/api/v1/call-events and /codestra/api/v1/call-events/{event_id}) to the placeholder 'https://redacted-internal-odoo-proxy.invalid:8443'. This repo's AGENTS.md prohibits committing production host addresses; the original upstream value was verified byte-identical to source_sha before being redacted here, and is deliberately not reproduced in this file.

Removed the invalid `schema` field from five channel Parameter Objects (agentEvents.tenant_id/campaign_id/agent_id, supervisorEvents.tenant_id/campaign_id) -- AsyncAPI 3.0 Parameter Objects support only enum/default/description/examples/location, not schema.
